name: Captodiame
summary: Captodiame (INN), also known as captodiamine, is an antihistamine sold under the trade names Covatine, Covatix, and Suvren which is used as a sedative and anxiolytic. The structure is related to diphenhydramine.

pharmacology.text: It produces antidepressant-like effects in rats.

uses.text: Captodiame (INN), also known as captodiamine, is an antihistamine sold under the trade names Covatine, Covatix, and Suvren which is used as a sedative and anxiolytic. A 2004 study suggested captodiame may be helpful in preventing benzodiazepine withdrawal syndrome in people discontinuing benzodiazepine treatment.

summaryZh: 卡普托胺是一種抗組胺藥，可用作鎮靜劑和抗焦慮藥。它的結構與苯海拉明相關。
summaryZhHans: 卡普托胺是一种抗组胺药，可用作镇静剂和抗焦虑药。它的结构与苯海拉明相关。

sideEffects.en: It has been little studied. Drowsiness is the main effect reported, and as a sedating antihistamine it may also cause dry mouth and dizziness.
sideEffects.zh: 它的研究很少。主要被報告的作用是嗜睡，作為具鎮靜作用的抗組織胺，它也可能造成口乾與頭暈。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它的研究很少。主要被报告的作用是嗜睡，作为具镇静作用的抗组织胺，它也可能造成口干与头晕。

fact.en: Its structure is related to diphenhydramine, but where diphenhydramine has an oxygen atom linking its two halves, captodiame has a sulfur atom, and it carries a second sulfur on one of its rings.
fact.zh: 它的結構與苯海拉明相近，但苯海拉明連接分子兩半的是氧原子，卡普托胺則是硫原子，而且它的其中一個環上還帶有第二個硫原子。
fact.zhHans: 它的结构与苯海拉明相近，但苯海拉明连接分子两半的是氧原子，卡普托胺则是硫原子，而且它的其中一个环上还带有第二个硫原子。
